evidence.observation: Purge brought exhaust O2 down from about 28,800 to 15 ppm; it has stayed at 4-7 ppm since.
Brief overshoot to 760.4 °C when growth started, then settled at 750 ± 0.7 °C.
Heater power is steady at about 46-48% during the hold, which fits a temperature that is holding on target.
Argon flow is 100 ± 1 sccm, matching the setpoint.
Pressure is steady at about 3.1 Torr; no sign of a leak or blocked exhaust.

args.missing_evidence: No sample characterization yet. There are also no reference ranges from normal runs, so the heater-power level cannot be checked against past runs.
